page.intro_en: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has released a recruitment notification for filling up 1 vacancy for the post of Foreign Language Advisor in the Intelligence Bureau on a deputation basis. Interested and eligible candidates who meet the prescribed criteria can apply through the proper channel. This page provides all essential details regarding the recruitment, eligibility, and application procedure.
